messages:
Mika: Heads-up — noticed p95 spikes on prod after rolling the 'dynamic_token_budget' canary around 04:15 UTC. Perf-bot posted an alert.
perf-bot: [ALERT] p95 latency > 600ms on route /generate/chat (tier: standard). Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/alerts/route-p95-55321
Samir: saw it too. quick glance: microbatch sizes dropped, and kernel dispatch time per microbatch rose slightly. can we grab a flame/sample?
Cheng: KV hit rate is down ~18% for that route in the same window (04:15-04:25). suspect cache churn.
Dana: attaching short flame sample from the worst node (04:17-04:22): ```
# top functions
inference_loop 52%
kv_lookup 18%
kernel_dispatch 12%
batch_formation 8%
other 10%
``` 
Samir: interesting — kernel_dispatch increased even though raw token throughput was similar. maybe the kernel selector chose a different kernel because sequence-length distribution shifted with smaller microbatches.
Mika: config we rolled on canary group: ```
queue_policy: dynamic_token_budget
min_batch_tokens: 32
route_tier_targets:
  standard: 1200
  premium: 1600
early_cutoff: enabled
``` 
Cheng: early_cutoff can shorten the time window for KV prefetch/warmup. combined with smaller target token budgets that could kill KV efficiency.
Dana: simplified hypothesis: dynamic_token_budget reduced the effective token target for standard route -> average microbatch token count decreased -> fewer KV refs per batch -> kv_hit_rate drop -> per-token kernel overhead appears higher -> p95 rises.
Samir: actionable: 1) bump `route_tier_targets.standard` back to 1600 on canary hosts, 2) collect microbatch size hist, kv_hit_rate, kernel_choice counts, and kernel latency per seq-len bucket.
Mika: agree. also add a temporary metric `batch_kv_efficiency = tokens_served / kv_lookups` so we can gate early_cutoff.
deploy-bot: initiating partial rollout - overriding param on 5 canary hosts: `route_tier_targets.standard=1600`. Tracking rollout id: rto-55321.
perf-bot: test suggestion — run a synthetic mix (70% short sequences, 30% long) against canary group to reproduce the distribution shift.
Cheng: I'll run profiling and post microbatch hist + KV hit heatmap in ~30m.
Dana: quick safety idea: short-term guard in batcher: if `kv_hit_rate(route) < 0.6`, disable `early_cutoff` for that route for 10 minutes. I can drop a small PR.
Samir: also capture kernel selection deltas: how often did we change kernel for the same max_seq_len after the canary? that would show selector instability.
Mika: plan of record: Cheng -> profile + produce microbatch histogram & kv heatmap; Samir -> kernel-select trace + kernel latency by seq-len; Dana -> small guard PR + metric; Mika -> monitor rollout + dashboards. Re-evaluate in 45m.
Samir: FYI, logging snippet to enable for traces: `log.debug("kernel_choice", route=route, seq_len_bucket=bucket, kernel=sel)` — add sampling.
Cheng: noted. will enable low-sample tracing for 10m.
Mika: thanks. ping here if anything spikes again. :thumbsup:
